name: @activepieces/piece-mailgun
description: Email delivery service for sending, receiving, and tracking emails

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Mailgun dashboard](https://app.mailgun.com)
2. Go to **Settings > API Security**
3. Copy your **Private API Key** (starts with `key-`)

api_key.description: Your Mailgun private API key (starts with `key-`)

region.description: Select the region your Mailgun account is in. Most accounts use US.

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Send an email using your Mailgun domain

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple recipients, separate with commas.

cc.description: Carbon copy recipients, separated by commas.

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipients, separated by commas.

text.description: Plain text version of the email body.

html.description: HTML version of the email body.

aiMetadata.description: Send an outbound email through a verified Mailgun sending domain, with optional CC/BCC/Reply-To and either a plain-text or HTML body (at least one body is required). Choose this to deliver transactional or notification mail. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new message.

validate_email.name: validate_email
validate_email.description: Validate an email address using Mailgun validation service. Requires a Mailgun account with email validation enabled.

providerLookup.description: Enable additional mailbox provider checks for more accurate results.

aiMetadata.description: Check whether a single email address is deliverable via Mailgun email verification, optionally enabling mailbox-provider lookup for higher accuracy. Use to screen an address before sending or storing it. Requires email validation enabled on the Mailgun account. Idempotent: a read-only lookup that does not change anything.

add_mailing_list_member.name: add_mailing_list_member
add_mailing_list_member.description: Add a new member to a Mailgun mailing list

address.description: The email address to add to the mailing list.

upsert.description: If enabled, updates the member if they already exist. Otherwise, an error is returned for duplicates.

subscribed.description: Set the subscription status of the member.

vars.description: JSON object with custom variables to store with this member, e.g. {"age": 30, "city": "Paris"}.

aiMetadata.description: Add a subscriber to a Mailgun mailing list, identified by the list address, with an optional display name and custom variables. The "Update If Exists" toggle controls the duplicate mode: when enabled it upserts on the member email (idempotent), and when disabled a repeat add for the same address returns an error. Choose this to grow or update a mailing list.

get_events.name: get_events
get_events.description: Retrieve email events from your Mailgun domain (deliveries, failures, opens, clicks, etc.). Useful for monitoring and alerting.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

severity.description: Only applies to "failed" events. Filter by permanent (hard bounce) or temporary (soft bounce).

begin.description: Start of the time range. RFC 2822 date (e.g. "Fri, 28 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0000") or Unix timestamp (e.g. "1711620000"). Leave empty for Mailgun default (about 30 days ago).

end.description: End of the time range. Same format as Begin Date. Leave empty for now.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default is 100, max is 1000. Mailgun returns up to 300 per page — pagination is handled automatically.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a domain's email event log filtered by a single event type (delivered, failed, opened, clicked, etc.), with optional severity, time range, and result cap; pagination is handled automatically. For "failed" events the severity filter can narrow to permanent (hard) or temporary (soft) bounces. Use to inspect or monitor recent email activity. Idempotent: a read-only query.

get_domain_stats.name: get_domain_stats
get_domain_stats.description: Retrieve aggregated email statistics for a Mailgun domain (delivered, failed, opened, etc.). Useful for monitoring delivery health and detecting anomalies.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

event.description: Select which event types to include in the statistics.

duration.description: Time period to aggregate stats over.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve aggregated counts for a Mailgun domain across selected event types over a chosen duration (1 hour to 30 days), summed into totals. Use for delivery-health dashboards or anomaly detection rather than per-message detail. Idempotent: a read-only aggregation.

list_bounces.name: list_bounces
list_bounces.description: Retrieve the list of bounced email addresses for a Mailgun domain. Useful for cleanup after delivery issues or spam attacks.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

limit.description: Maximum number of bounces to return (1-1000). Default is 100.

aiMetadata.description: List the addresses on a Mailgun domain's bounce suppression list, up to a result cap. Use to review or export bounced recipients, often before cleaning up the suppression list. Idempotent: a read-only listing.

delete_bounces_bulk.name: delete_bounces_bulk
delete_bounces_bulk.description: Remove bounced addresses from the Mailgun suppression list, either all at once for a domain or a single address.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

scope.description: Delete all bounces for the domain, or a single address.

address.description: Email address to remove from the bounce list. Required when Scope is "Single address".

aiMetadata.description: Delete entries from a Mailgun domain's bounce suppression list. The scope selects the mode: "all" clears every bounce for the domain, while "single" removes one address (which is then required). Use to re-enable sending to addresses that previously bounced. Idempotent: deleting an already-absent bounce leaves the same end state with no extra effect.

get_domain_health.name: get_domain_health
get_domain_health.description: Fetch the health of a Mailgun domain: current state, whether it has been disabled, and DNS verification status for sending and receiving records.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a Mailgun domain's configuration health: its current state, whether it is disabled, and whether the sending and receiving DNS records are fully verified. Use to confirm a domain is ready to send or to diagnose setup problems. Idempotent: a read-only lookup.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Mailgun dashboard](https://app.mailgun.com)
2. Go to **Settings > API Security**
3. Copy your **Private API Key** (starts with `key-`)

api_key.description: Your Mailgun private API key (starts with `key-`)

region.description: Select the region your Mailgun account is in. Most accounts use US.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Mailgun dashboard](https://app.mailgun.com)
2. Go to **Settings > API Security**
3. Copy your **Private API Key** (starts with `key-`)

api_key.description: Your Mailgun private API key (starts with `key-`)

region.description: Select the region your Mailgun account is in. Most accounts use US.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_bounce_event.name: new_bounce_event
new_bounce_event.description: Triggers when an email permanently fails to deliver (hard bounce) in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Mailgun records a permanent delivery failure (hard bounce) for a sent email, meaning the address is undeliverable and should not be retried. Represents a single bounced recipient with the failure reason and SMTP details.

sampleData.delivery_status_description: The email account does not exist

new_complaint_event.name: new_complaint_event
new_complaint_event.description: Triggers when a recipient reports an email as spam in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient marks a delivered email as spam (a complaint) in Mailgun. Represents a single complaint event and is a signal to suppress future sends to that recipient.

new_delivery_event.name: new_delivery_event
new_delivery_event.description: Triggers when an email is successfully delivered in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Mailgun confirms an email was accepted by the recipient mail server (successful delivery). Represents a single delivered message.

new_failed_delivery_event.name: new_failed_delivery_event
new_failed_delivery_event.description: Triggers when an email temporarily fails to deliver in Mailgun (will be retried)

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Mailgun records a temporary delivery failure (soft bounce) for an email, which Mailgun will automatically retry. Represents a single transient failure with its reason and SMTP details; distinct from a permanent hard bounce.

new_open_event.name: new_open_event
new_open_event.description: Triggers when a recipient opens an email in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Mailgun detects that a recipient opened a tracked email. Represents a single open event with client and device details; requires open tracking enabled on the domain.

new_click_event.name: new_click_event
new_click_event.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link in an email in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient clicks a tracked link in an email in Mailgun. Represents a single click event including the clicked URL plus client and device details; requires click tracking enabled on the domain.

new_unsubscribe_event.name: new_unsubscribe_event
new_unsubscribe_event.description: Triggers when a recipient unsubscribes from emails in Mailgun

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient unsubscribes from emails sent through the Mailgun domain. Represents a single unsubscribe event and is a signal to stop sending to that recipient.

bulk_bounce_threshold_exceeded.name: bulk_bounce_threshold_exceeded
bulk_bounce_threshold_exceeded.description: Triggers once when too many emails bounce within a set time period. Useful for catching spam attacks or deliverability problems early.

domain.description: Select the Mailgun domain to use

threshold.description: How many bounced emails within the time window will trigger this.

window_minutes.description: How far back to look for bounces.

severity.description: Which type of bounces to count.

aiMetadata.description: Fires once when the number of bounced emails for a domain exceeds a configured threshold within a rolling time window, counting permanent, temporary, or all failures depending on the chosen bounce type. Represents a deliverability incident (e.g. a spam attack or sudden delivery problems) and re-arms only after counts fall back below the threshold, so a sustained spike does not fire repeatedly.

nl.Send an email using your Mailgun domain: Stuur een e-mail met uw Mailgun domein

nl.Retrieve the list of bounced email addre: Haal de lijst op met bounced e-mailadressen voor een Mailgun domein. Handig voor opschonen na levering problemen of spam aanvallen.
nl.Remove bounced addresses from the Mailgu: Verwijder bounced adressen uit de Mailgun onderdrukkingslijst, allemaal tegelijk voor een domein of een enkel adres.
nl.Fetch the health of a Mailgun domain: cu: Ophalen van de gezondheid van een Mailgun domein: de huidige staat, of het is uitgeschakeld, en de DNS-verificatie status voor het verzenden en ontvangen van records.

nl.Blind carbon copy recipients, separated: Blinde carbon copy recipients, gescheiden door komma's.
Platte tekst versie van de inhoud van de e-mail.
HTML versie van de inhoud van de e-mail.
nl.Enable additional mailbox provider check: Schakel extra controle van de mailbox provider in voor nauwkeurigere resultaten.
nl.The email address to add to the mailing: Het e-mailadres om toe te voegen aan de mailinglijst.
nl.If enabled, updates the member if they a: Indien ingeschakeld, update het lid als deze al bestaat. Anders wordt er een fout geretourneerd voor duplicaten.
nl.Set the subscription status of the membe: Stel de abonnementsstatus van het lid in.
nl.JSON object with custom variables to sto: JSON object met aangepaste variabelen om op te slaan met dit lid, bijvoorbeeld {"leeftijd": 30, "city": "Parijs"}.
nl.Only applies to \"failed\" events. Filte: Geldt alleen voor "mislukte" gebeurtenissen. Filter op permanent (hard bounce) of tijdelijk (soft bounce).
nl.Start of the time range. RFC 2822 date (: Begin van het tijdsbereik. RFC 2822 datum (bijv. "Vrij, 28 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0000") of Unix tijdstempel (bijv. . "1711620000"). Laat leeg voor Mailgun standaard (ongeveer 30 dagen geleden).
nl.End of the time range. Same format as Be: Einde van het tijdsbereik. Dezelfde indeling als de begindatum. Laat leeg voor nu.

nl.Select which event types to include in t: Selecteer welke gebeurtenistypes in de statistieken moeten worden opgenomen.
Tijd periode om statistieken over te verzamelen.
nl.Maximum number of bounces to return (1-1: Maximum aantal bounces om terug te keren (1-1000). Standaard is 100.
nl.Delete all bounces for the domain, or a: Verwijder alle bounces voor het domein, of een enkel adres.

nl.Triggers when a recipient unsubscribes f: Triggert wanneer een ontvanger zich uitschrijft van e-mails in Mailgun

nl.How many bounced emails within the time: Hoeveel bounced e-mails in het tijdsvenster zullen dit activeren.
Hoe ver terug te zoeken naar stuiteren.

de.Email delivery service for sending, rece: E-Mail-Zustellservice zum Versenden, Empfangen und Tracking von E-Mails
de.Select the region your Mailgun account i: Wählen Sie die Region, in der sich Ihr Mailgun-Konto befindet. Die meisten Konten verwenden USA.
de.To get your API key:\n1. Log in to your:
Um Ihren API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:
1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem [Mailgun Dashboard](https://app.mailgun.com)
2. Gehe zu **Einstellungen > API-Sicherheit**
3. Kopiere deinen **privaten API-Schlüssel** (beginnt mit `key-`)
de.Send an email using your Mailgun domain: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit Ihrer Mailgun-Domain
de.Validate an email address using Mailgun: Überprüfen Sie eine E-Mail-Adresse mit dem Mailgun-Validierungsdienst. Benötigt ein Mailgun-Konto mit aktivierter E-Mail-Validierung.
de.Retrieve email events from your Mailgun: Mail-Ereignisse von Ihrer Mailgun-Domain abrufen (Lieferungen, Ausfälle, Öffnungen, Klicks etc.). Nützlich für Überwachung und Warnung.
de.Retrieve aggregated email statistics for: Rufen Sie aggregierte E-Mail-Statistiken für eine Mailgun-Domain ab (geliefert, fehlgeschlagen, geöffnet, etc.). Nützlich für die Überwachung der Liefergesundheit und die Erkennung von Anomalien.
de.Retrieve the list of bounced email addre: Die Liste der abgeworfenen E-Mail-Adressen für eine Mailgun-Domain abrufen. Nützlich für die Bereinigung nach Zustell- oder Spam-Angriffen.
de.Remove bounced addresses from the Mailgu: Entfernen Sie abgeworfene Adressen aus der Mailgun-Liste für eine Domain oder eine einzelne Adresse.
de.Fetch the health of a Mailgun domain: cu: Holen Sie die Gesundheit einer Mailgun-Domäne: aktueller Zustand, ob sie deaktiviert wurde, und DNS-Status für das Senden und Empfangen von Datensätzen.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Recipient email address. For multiple re: E-Mail-Adresse des Empfängers. Für mehrere Empfänger mit Komma trennen.
de.Carbon copy recipients, separated by com: Empfänger von Kohlenstoffkopien, durch Kommata getrennt.
de.Blind carbon copy recipients, separated: Empfänger blinder Kohlenstoffkopie, durch Kommata getrennt.
de.Enable additional mailbox provider check: Aktivieren Sie zusätzliche Überprüfungen des Postfachanbieters auf genauere Ergebnisse.
de.The email address to add to the mailing: Die E-Mail-Adresse, die zur Mailingliste hinzugefügt werden soll.
de.If enabled, updates the member if they a: Wenn aktiviert, aktualisiert das Mitglied, falls es bereits existiert, andernfalls wird ein Fehler bei Duplikaten zurückgegeben.
de.Set the subscription status of the membe: Legen Sie den Status des Mitglieds fest.
de.JSON object with custom variables to sto: JSON-Objekt mit benutzerdefinierten Variablen, die mit diesem Mitglied gespeichert werden sollen, z.B. {"age": 30, "city": "Paris"}.
de.Only applies to \"failed\" events. Filte: Gilt nur für "fehlgeschlagene Ereignisse. Filter nach permanent (harter Abprallung) oder temporär (weicher Absprung).
de.Start of the time range. RFC 2822 date (: Start des Zeitraums. RFC 2822 Datum (z.B. "Fri, 28 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0000") oder Unix Timestamp (e. . "1711620000"). Leer lassen für Mailgun Standard (vor etwa 30 Tagen).
de.End of the time range. Same format as Be: Ende des Zeitbereichs. Gleiches Format wie Startdatum. Leer lassen.
de.Maximum number of events to return. Defa: Maximale Anzahl der zurückzugebenden Ereignisse. Standard ist 100, max ist 1000. Mailgun gibt bis zu 300 pro Seite zurück — die Seitenumstellung wird automatisch bearbeitet.
de.Select which event types to include in t: Wählen Sie aus, welche Ereignistypen in die Statistiken aufgenommen werden sollen.
de.Maximum number of bounces to return (1-1: Maximale Anzahl der Rückgabewerte (1-1000). Standard ist 100.
de.Delete all bounces for the domain, or a: Löschen Sie alle Bounces für die Domain oder eine einzelne Adresse.
de.Email address to remove from the bounce: E-Mail-Adresse, die von der Bounce-Liste entfernt werden soll. Wird benötigt, wenn Scope "Einzelne Adresse" ist.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.
de.HEAD: HEAD
de.Triggers when an email permanently fails: Löst aus, wenn eine E-Mail in Mailgun (harter Absprung) nicht ausgeliefert wird
de.Triggers when a recipient reports an ema: Löst aus, wenn ein Empfänger eine E-Mail als Spam in Mailgun meldet
de.Triggers when an email is successfully d: Löst aus, wenn eine E-Mail erfolgreich in Mailgun versendet wurde
de.Triggers when an email temporarily fails: Löst aus, wenn eine E-Mail temporär nicht in Mailgun geliefert wird (wird erneut versucht)
de.Triggers when a recipient opens an email: Löst aus, wenn ein Empfänger eine E-Mail in Mailgun öffnet
de.Triggers when a recipient clicks a track: Löst aus, wenn ein Empfänger einen Tracking-Link in einer E-Mail in Mailgun klickt
de.Triggers when a recipient unsubscribes f: Löst aus, wenn ein Empfänger E-Mails in Mailgun abbestellt hat
de.Triggers once when too many emails bounc: Löst einmal aus, wenn zu viele E-Mails innerhalb einer bestimmten Zeit abprallen. Nützlich zum Fangen von Spam-Attacken oder zur frühzeitigen Zustellbarkeit.
de.How many bounced emails within the time: Wie viele ausgelaufene E-Mails innerhalb des Zeitfensters dies auslösen wird.
Wie weit zurück zu suchen nach Bounces.
Welcher Typ von Bounces zu zählen.
